name: desu-ai-plugins
description: A small marketplace of Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: shunt-agy
plugins.description: Shunts I/O-heavy work (bulk file reads, boilerplate generation) to a cheaper model via the agy (Antigravity) CLI. Hooks block large reads and redirect to bulk-reader/code-writer scripts.

plugins.name: unifi
plugins.description: Read-only view of your UniFi network (clients, devices, networks, WiFi, firewall, VPN) through the official UniFi Network API, from the cloud or straight from your console.
